note: The page's entries before Program Partner kept the What's new list (plan WN-7, 26 November 2026). Used only when a build can't read the list and has no copy kept. Not edited: entries are written in Program Partner now.

entries.title: Auditions
entries.body: Any school program can take audition sign-ups from a public link, with no account needed. Families can send a video link or upload the video to the program's own Google Drive. Directors call back, cast the show on a casting board with alternates and crew, publish the cast to their roster and send the cast messages.

entries.title: Calendar import by link
entries.body: Add any calendar feed by its link, such as your school's or district's calendar, and its events come into your program calendar and stay in sync.

entries.title: The front office for private studios
entries.body: Studios get a Today home screen and a four-step setup. Families can see their lessons and notes, cancel within your policy, book from your open times and sign your studio policy. Lesson reminders go out about a day ahead, inquiries come in from a form you share, and families can save a card or bank account for autopay with your own payment account.

entries.title: A plan for private studios
entries.body: Private studios have their own plan, billed monthly or yearly, with every feature included.

entries.title: See who acknowledged a behavior notice
entries.body: Directors see which guardian acknowledged each behavior notice and when. A guardian can add one optional note with the acknowledgement, and you can reply through Messages.

entries.title: Published pricing and online subscribing
entries.body: One yearly price per school program, with every feature included. Subscribe online, or pay by purchase order or check.

entries.title: An access control review of the whole platform
entries.body: Andrew Casal tested Program Partner as a director, a parent and a student in two test schools, checking who can see and change which records, then retested every fix.

entries.title: Program Partner moves to its own hosting
entries.body: The app now runs on its own hosting and its own database, with off-site backups kept for 30 days.

entries.title: Fewer surprises before something is saved or sent
entries.body: Program Partner now asks before throwing away unsaved edits and before one-tap deletes. Before a new fee, a credit or a bulk payment is saved, it shows who is affected and the total, and families' form answers are kept as a draft until they submit.

entries.title: Behavior notices reach guardians right away
entries.body: When you log an incident, guardians get the notice straight away, with a nightly reminder until someone acknowledges it.

entries.title: Hold event sign-up for past-due fees
entries.body: Turn on a setting for any optional event, and a student can't sign up until their fees are paid. Fees that aren't due yet don't count, and you can make an exception.

entries.title: Bus assignments and printable event rosters
entries.body: Assign travelers to buses, filter and group them quickly, and print rosters for the trip.
